scenarios.finalMessagePreview:
Saved to [answer.md](C:/Users/forre/AppData/Local/Temp/plugin-eval-case-1-XaP4Xn/workspace/answer.md).

Found **Alabama HB591 — 2026 Regular Session**.

- **Title:** Rural Health Transformation Program supplemental appropriations for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026.
- **Recorded status:** Passed; record dated April 13, 2026.
- **Summary:** Provides up to $203,404,327 in federal funds to the Alabama Department of Economic and Community Affairs for rural health initiatives and creates a joint legislative oversight committee.
- **Official text:** [Enrolled HB591 PDF, dated April 9, 2026](https://alison.legislature.state.al.us/files/pdf/SearchableInstruments/2026RS/HB591-enr.pdf).

Source: Cicada Guide’s exact bill search and latest-document tools. The recorded status and enrolled document do not by themselves establish governor approval or enactment.

scenarios.title: Read bill and show workspace
scenarios.purpose: Read bill and show workspace. Setup: fresh chat with Cicada Guide enabled; public live records, no credentials.
successChecklist: Resolve the exact bill and read every text chunk before summarizing, or disclose unavailable text. Accept dossier roll calls when rollcalls.has_more is false, count and total equal items.length, and no warning indicates failed or incomplete floor-vote retrieval. Otherwise continue get_rollcalls with the same bill_id and returned next_offset; start at offset 0 if completeness metadata is missing/inconsistent or retrieval failed. Follow pagination and retain warnings; disclose any unresolved incomplete coverage even when has_more is false. Preserve each tally and dated status. Show the bill with id, headline and summary grounded in returned evidence. A complete dossier does not require a duplicate get_rollcalls call.
Expected tool coverage: list_states, list_sessions, search_bills, get_bill_dossier, get_latest_bill_document, show_bill
